name: Velouté
body:
Station and Complexity rotisseur 3, saucier 2

Flavor Profiles umami, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, or spicy

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 3

DESCRIPTION

Velouté is a clear sauce made of chicken, veal, or fish stock, thickened with milk and egg yolks. It can be used in place of a temperature ingredient or as an additional umami ingredient when creating a meal.

When added in this way, it grants a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for the meal’s duration, in addition to the meal’s effect.

Additional ingredients increase the bonus and serving size by +1 each and allow the velouté to be used in place of that type of flavor profile as well.
